name: log-in-with-ethos
title: Log in with Ethos
description: Example app that shows how to add Log in with Ethos to a React app through Privy.

services.name: privy
services.purpose: Log in with Ethos (cross-app sign-in), in the browser only

services.name: ethos-api
services.purpose: Fetches the Ethos profile for the signed-in Ethos Everywhere wallet, from the browser

notes: Static site with no server code. The Privy app ID is a build-time value (VITE_PRIVY_APP_ID in .env.local).
